meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读入并组织单细胞测序产生的注释矩阵,为下游分析打好基础。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果处理单细胞测序结果,需要按注释矩阵整理基因表达数据。
copy.tagline_en: Read and organize annotated single-cell matrices for downstream analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle single-cell sequencing data and need a standard way to organize annotated expression matrices.

howto.what: Claude 会按 AnnData 规范帮你创建、读取、写入 .h5ad/.zarr 等带注释的数据矩阵，做子集筛选、多数据集合并和元数据管理，并给出对应的 Python 代码。
howto.when: 当你处理 .h5ad、.zarr 文件，或要在 scverse 生态里读写带注释的矩阵时接管；分析流程转用 scanpy，概率模型转用 scvi-tools。

say.text: 把这个 h5ad 文件读进来，看看有多少细胞和基因
say.note: 会读取 .h5ad 并报告维度

say.text: 把这三个批次的 h5ad 按批次标签合并成一个
say.note: 用 ad.concat 合并并加 batch 标签

say.text: 数据太大内存放不下，用 backed 模式打开并保留筛选后的子集
say.note: 先 backed='r' 懒加载，再 to_memory()

howto.what_en: Claude will create, read, and write AnnData objects such as .h5ad and .zarr files, subset and concatenate annotated matrices, manage metadata, and output the matching Python code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you work with .h5ad or .zarr files, or read and write annotated matrices in the scverse ecosystem. Analysis workflows go to scanpy, probabilistic models to scvi-tools.
